question: What was India’s sex ratio in 1951?
solution:
The correct answer is __**946 females per 1000 males.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Sex Ratio of India in the year 1951 is **946 Females per 1000 males.**
 
• The sex ratio is **the ratio of females to males in a population **in any particular country.
 
• According to the Experts of Population Science, Health, and women's studies says a healthy Child Ratio works around to **950-970 girls per 1,000 boys.**
 
• The Perfect Sex Ratio was in the year **1961.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• ** ****Some States with their Sex Ratio as per the 2011 Census:**__

 
 
• Kerala-1084 females per 1000 males(Highest Sex Ratio).
 
• Haryana: 877 females per 1000 males(Lowest Sex Ratio).
 
• Dadar and Nagar Haveli: 774 females per 1000 males(Second Lowest Sex Ratio).
